looks.label: Slot material swap with tint
looks.technique: Each body part swaps its two material digits from the server slot value, then takes that slot's tint; faces are never tinted.

looks.label: Posture hold
looks.technique: Sit, crouch, kneel and lie transitions hold the final frame; crouch-walk clip while moving crouched; posture never moves the body.

looks.label: Waiting pulse on the ability bar
looks.technique: A waiting state pulses its brightness with a sine on the clock between about 0.35 and 0.60.

looks.label: Depth-tested ground ring
looks.technique: Ring follows the selected entity on the ground, respects scene depth, and hides when the target is unavailable.

looks.label: Window fade on pointer leave
looks.technique: Window background holds its alpha, waits a delay, then fades to a second alpha over a duration.

looks.label: Bag colour per storage slot
looks.technique: A tinted group per bag; colour belongs to the storage slot and not to the item, and lasts for the session.

originals.name: Gear by swap and tint
originals.idea: Each body slot takes a material from the server slot value and a tint from the same slot; faces are never tinted.
originals.keep: Slot-coded swap, per-slot tint, face protection (parity row 15 gear dressing).

originals.name: Posture from state, hold the last frame
originals.idea: Sit, crouch, kneel and lie hold their final frame, move with a crouch-walk clip, and never move the body.
originals.keep: The hold and the no-move rule (parity rows 6 and 7).

originals.name: Pending-cast pulse with manual retry
originals.idea: The ability bar pulses while the server has not confirmed a cast; no automatic resend; a fresh manual attempt after five seconds.
originals.keep: Never auto-resend; visible pending state (parity rows 13 and 14).

originals.name: Ground ring by state
originals.idea: A depth-tested ring follows the selected body and hides when the target is not available.
originals.keep: Depth test and hide rule (parity row 14 HUD).

originals.name: Stable target cycle
originals.idea: Tab cycles nearby entities in stable ID order, a key selects self, Escape clears.

originals.name: Fall damage with a harmless band
originals.idea: No damage up to a harmless drop, then growth with the square of the drop, with a capped mitigation skill.
originals.keep: Harmless band and cap. Candidate movement rule; no parity row covers falls yet.

originals.name: Waterline wading
originals.idea: Shallow water is waded; deep water stops the walk.
originals.keep: The waterline rule. Candidate under zone data; row 23 covers spawns only.

originals.name: Window fade on pointer leave
originals.idea: Hold, then delay, then fade to a set alpha over a duration.

originals.name: Resurrection confirm with a name
originals.idea: A dialog states who offers, with Yes and No.
originals.keep: An explicit accept step that names the caster (parity row 17).

originals.name: Draw budget at 375 wide
originals.idea: A default distance and a hard cap of 200 entities drawn.
originals.keep: Cap and default distance (parity row 11 camera and row 23 population).
